thig3.5:1.1: amma Jīvā ti vanamhi kandasi attānaṃ adhigaccha Ubbiri. | cūḷāsītisahassāni sabbā Jīvasanāmikā | etamh' āḷāhane daḍḍhā tāsaṃ kam anusocasi. || ||
thig3.5:2.1: abbuhi vata me sallaṃ duddasaṃ hadayanissitaṃ | yaṃ me sokaparetāya dhītu sokaṃ byapānudi. || ||
thig3.5:3.1: sājja abbūḷhasallāhaṃ nicchātā parinibbutā | buddhaṃ dhammañ ca saṅghañ ca upemi saraṇaṃ muniṃ. || || Ubbirī. ||
